name: CIMC Safeway Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: CIMC Safeway Technologies Co., Ltd. engages in the design, research, development, manufacture, and sale of tank containers in North America, Mainland China, the rest of Asia, Europe, South America, and Oceania. It offers standard and special tank containers, gas tanks, and carbon steel tank containers; and smart devices, such as intelligent sensing and temperature controls, and digital logistics. The company also provides aftermarket services, including cleaning, repair, periodic inspection, and storage during tank container use.
